ctx.x: Who were the musicians that you really enjoyed playing and you think were really good?

Well, musicians I enjoyed playing with like Russ, Willie Humphrey, now Willie Humphrey come back here. They come back here and if you want to use a stick, I said, no, don't worry about the planet and get on the alto. So he got on the alto and started working that. I said, we got two of them. I said, we're going back there to St. Monica's, they got all them hells back there but we're going to give them religion tonight when we go back there. And the number when I played back there, just said come out, just before…
